steps.content:
June 16, N.F. 115 at 11:40 AM
The Great Expo

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Whoa, check this out. There are actually wild vegetables grown in the Outlands. Don't let the rustic look fool you, they're apparently packed with nutrients. Seems perfect for those mindful of their macros or following a low-carb lifestyle.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Okay guys, I just saw some ore from the... some shelter mining area! Now... I know it might look a little plain. But who knows? They might find gems in there someday.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Oh, look at this! It's a newly unearthed pre-Nightfall organism fossil, one that symbolizes disaster and death. Did you know? DisCity museums used to display complete fossil skeletons as well. I remember seeing them as a child.
Thalia guides her livestream viewers through each Outlands exhibition area, offering explanations and comments about the dazzling array of exhibits on display.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Eastia's running a little behind schedule since they've got quite the journey to make, and their venue is still being prepared. Let's all keep our fingers crossed they arrive with time to spare.
At the mention of the Outlands and Eastia, the chat explodes to life, though the tone is far from friendly.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Actually, that's not quite right. DisCity and the Outlands have always been deeply connected. During the Nightfall, when DisCity was first established, many Outland forces contributed both people and resources. In fact, some of the most well-known families in Eastside and Paradeisos today can trace their roots back generations to the Outlands. Even my own ancestors...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: ...So you see, the Outlands have their own rich historical heritage. And our resource exchange with them has been a cornerstone of DisCity's prosperity.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Now then, next up—Eek!
The young streamer is startled by the cry of a live sandworm.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Oh my! A sandworm? Or a Corruptor?

steps.speaker: Outland Exhibitor
steps.content: @#￥@%&* (Hey there, gorgeous! Want to check out our exhibition?)

steps.speaker: Outland Exhibitor
steps.content: #@￥@%@#@#￥@% (Yes yes. We've also got some amazing tech to share. Come, come! Take a look! You've been turning heads—please help us get some attention! I'll give you something in return!)
The Outlander digs out a brochure and hands it to Thalia, along with a bulky package of Outland gifts, making a determined effort to promote their product.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: W-wait, hold on—

Thalia instinctively wants to step back, but the product name on the brochure catches her attention. More importantly, her streamer instincts flare: an official Great Expo camera is hidden behind that pillar, following her movements, likely drawn by her popularity.

The thought hits her—millions, or maybe even more, are watching the official broadcast behind that lens. All those potential viewers she's been chasing. Thalia shakes off the last traces of unease, her posture straightening as professional instinct takes over.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: You're so right! Technological progress and exchange are just as crucial as anything else! Now, my lovely viewers, let your Thalia guide you through these amazing Outland breakthroughs!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Look closely here, this is actually a small practical application of Aurum Secretum, a calamity prevention method developed independently by the Outlands.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Aurum Secretum exhibits powerful resonance properties. Through harmonization and assimilation with pollutants, Hypercubes, and other substances, it can alter Mania field distribution within a certain time and range, redirecting Mania creatures or mutations away from human-inhabited zones. This helps reduce Hypercube consumption normally required for defensive measures while simultaneously ensuring human safety.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Truly remarkable! This Outland representative here wants to tell everyone that they're not just fighting for their survival—they're contributing to humanity's future as well. Let's all do our part to support this important cause, shall we?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: For those who haven't heard yet, Aurum Secretum is absolutely revolutionizing the tech world right now! Nirvana's been working closely with the Outlands on this, and after their latest breakthrough, their stock prices have been soaring through the roof!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: This event is simply overflowing with opportunities like this! Have you noticed how the stock market has been thriving throughout the Great Expo? It's precisely because investors are embracing all the new potential it's creating, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: The public exhibition here is just to open everyone's eyes, but the truly important conversations? Those are happening upstairs in the VIP lounge, where deals worth fortunes are being signed as we speak.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: The stock market is far too volatile for ordinary people. I've always believed in building success the steady way, with both feet on solid ground. However, if you really want my take...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: ...Surely I'd recommend DisFortune Weekly! They're running this wonderful special series about the Great Expo, and the Parfait's Dinner Invitation column is absolutely helpful for keeping up with upcoming trends!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: After all, we are talking about none other than the legendary <color=#fb9259>Parfait</color>—the stock market guru with an impeccable eye for opportunity! Any project that earns her attention is simply unmissable!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Wanna know Parfait's investment secrets? Then why not follow and subscribe? For just 88.88 DisCoins per year, you'll receive personal guidance from the legendary investor herself! Oh hey, the camera's gone... Well then, my dear friends, see you at the next stop!
[Scene Change] VIP Section, Near the Screen
In the hallway leading to the VIP section, Elvira stops in her tracks, her attention caught by the shot of Thalia in her livestream on the screen.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...That's the person who bumped into me earlier.

It turns out she is a streamer. When they ran into each other, Elvira imagined countless suspicious scenarios and worried about hidden agendas. Thankfully, those paranoid conspiracies are just in her head. Relief floods Elvira's chest.
But Hecate continues to stare at the screen, completely transfixed.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Does she seem off to you?
Hecate visibly stiffens, then murmurs as if waking from a trance.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No, I just... couldn't stop listening...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I've never been outside DisCity, so I don't really know what the Outlands are like. But last year, one of my friends went on an adventure in the WhiteSands. She told me a similar story in her last letter.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: One about how Outlanders survive using their own technology in places we can't see.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...I see.
Elvira pauses before turning her gaze back to the glowing screen alongside Hecate.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Truly remarkable! This Outland representative here wants to tell everyone that they're not just fighting for their survival—they're contributing to humanity's future as well. Let's all do our part to support this important cause, shall we?
The streamer's voice, passionate and sincere, fills the room. Both girls fall silent, each lost in their own thoughts.
Just then, footsteps and boisterous laughter echo from the other end of the hallway.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: <size=25>Someone's coming, this way!</size>

She grabs the nervous Elvira and yanks her behind a nearby door. Soon after, a few well-dressed adults walk down the hallway and stop beside the screen, right where the girls had stood moments earlier.
Several of them wear Nirvana representative badges, indicating positions of considerable authority.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Heh, that little Eastside streamer is just chasing clout. Look, she even mentioned you—your column in DisFortune.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Mmm... the cover photo does capture essence rather well. As one would expect from the renowned stock market guru. An excellent stylist choice. Is this another gem from your exclusive little black book of contacts? Any chance you could make an introduction?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: ...That vacant expression isn't helping anyone. No matter how boring this expo is, we have contracts to sign here. The Fraser representatives are waiting at the negotiation table, and those overseas assets won't manage themselves. Can't you at least pretend to care for their sake?
Investments thrive on prudence, and true wealth demands respect before acquisition. Wouldn't you agree, my friend?
Besides, we're all aware these exhibitions are simply theater. The real negotiations never happen in conference rooms. They occur at my dinner table... do they not?
As Elvira recognizes the speaker's identity, she simultaneously notices a faint, unusual fragrance.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: <size=25>...That's the financier Parfait Medici. But what's that scent on her...?</size>

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Haha, of course. Parfait's Dinner Party—a glimpse into the vision of the renowned stock market guru, the opportunity most financiers would kill for. So tell me, my dear financial guru, might I have the honor to dine with you at the closing gala in ten days?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: It would be even better if you could share with me what you've got your eye on these days, and your acquisition strategy. You're always so enigmatic about your investments.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Well... Not only has this second Black Ring created a new mine, but I hear it's also worsening disasters in the outer regions. Hypercube's value is guaranteed to soar. With some... strategic market plays, we could acquire premium overseas holdings for pennies.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Oh, and aren't you still building your overseas collection? I hear quite a selection has been brought in for auction this time, though I suspect there won't be that much time before they're gone. Don't hesitate if you wanna snag one or two.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Naturally. Though I can't help but notice Nirvana's rather... enthusiastic promotion of Fraser's Aurum Secretum. Shouldn't you be concerned about Hypercube's market position?
The Nirvana representative lets out a contemptuous scoff.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: If it could really replace Hypercube, why would Fraser come begging for cooperation? This "partnership" is just mutual publicity. It's more about trading influence to move markets and stocks than anything else.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Besides, these clowns are just renting Fraser's technology to develop some primitive applications. At least the Fraser representatives know to dress properly. Look at this rabble, dressed like they just stumbled out of a cave. Who would believe they can counter Mania? See? All the viewers are roasting them alive.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Heh, wanna bet they'll have a technical malfunction soon that'll leave them completely humiliated?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Oh! There it is! Look!
Through the screen, the crowd's screams and monsters' roars rip through the air. Both girls freeze, their breath catching.

steps.speaker: Broadcast
steps.content: Attention please. We are evacuating the public area due to an emergency situation. FAC has secured the site and is guiding the evacuation. Please remain calm, follow all instructions, and move quickly to the nearest exit—

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Oh, seriously...

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Do relax. This is all part of the demonstration. Nirvana's technical experts will take control of the situation any moment now. The public does love a good "crisis averted" narrative, after all.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Once the publicity of our technical alliance with Fraser is made, Nirvana's valuation will skyrocket. Just casually drop some praise at your dinner party—maybe throw in a flashy investment—and we're golden. People do listen to you, you know.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Just watch our Nirvana tech elites steal the show—Wait, what?? Who let this outsider jump into the fight?!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Oh?
Before Nirvana's experts can arrive, a reassuringly familiar figure appears on the screen.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
